body_long:
Rosewood Hotel Group has promoted Friedrich von Schönburg to Vice President, Operations, Asia-Pacific and Operations Excellence, Global. He will be based in Hong Kong from January 2027 and will report to Anthony Ingham, the group's chief operating officer.

In his new role he will oversee operations across Asia-Pacific, the region where Rosewood was born as a modern brand under its Hong Kong owner, and lead operational excellence for the group worldwide.

## A European palace operator

Friedrich von Schönburg trained at the École hôtelière de Lausanne. He joined the opening team of Rosewood London, then ran accommodation at two of London's most celebrated hotels, The Connaught and Claridge's. In 2019 he took over El Palace Barcelona as general manager.

Since August 2022 he has been managing director of Rosewood Villa Magna in Madrid, which reopened as the brand's first hotel in Spain, and regional vice president for Spain and Italy.

## Part of a wider reorganisation

The promotion was announced with two other global appointments: Sam Cooper as Vice President, Wellness, Global, in New York, and Gaye Gibson as Vice President, Retail and Partnerships, Global, in Hong Kong. Together they extend the reorganisation led by Anthony Ingham since he became COO in September 2025.

Rosewood Hotel Group manages more than 50 properties in 25 countries and territories, with more than 30 projects in development, including Shenzhen at the end of 2026 and Milan, Rome, Mexico and Crete in 2027.

## The signal

Sending a manager who built his career in London, Barcelona and Madrid to run Asia-Pacific tells us where Rosewood wants its operating standard set: on the European grand-hotel model of service, applied across a fast-growing Asian portfolio. For European general managers, it is also a reminder that Asian groups recruit their leadership from the palaces of Europe.

Congratulations to Friedrich von Schönburg on this new role.
summary: The managing director of Rosewood Villa Magna becomes VP Operations APAC and Operations Excellence, Global, based in Hong Kong, from January 2027.
